environment.machine: Apple M4 x10, 16 GiB, darwin 27.2.0 arm64

open-fresh.method: Same context; localStorage, IndexedDB and cache storage of the origin are cleared before each open (the HTTP cache of scripts stays warm).

send-resident.method: Type a tiny prompt, press Enter. start = Enter. sendingShownMs: first delivery state or new message in the page; acceptedMs: the new message with no pending delivery state; turnFinishedMs: assistant reply and Ready. Codex gets one tiny turn just before, so its runtime is loaded.

send-released.method: Type a tiny prompt, press Enter. start = Enter. sendingShownMs: first delivery state or new message in the page; acceptedMs: the new message with no pending delivery state; turnFinishedMs: assistant reply and Ready. The runtime is released 1500 ms before the page opens (Codex only; Claude Code has none to release).

release-continuity.method: Open the conversation, mark its first entry node, release the runtime, watch at least 15 s (release wait plus 15 s) without acting. Codex gets one tiny turn first, so there is a runtime to release.

provider-latency.method: Wall time of one agent-remote-controller-dev process (includes about 250 to 370 ms of process start; floorListMs is that floor). A send returns when the Controller accepted it. After a release the run waits 1500 ms; the first send after it is the wake.
